hero.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original website hero illustration, landscape 16:9, ideally 2560x1440 or comparable high resolution.
Primary request: An exquisitely detailed isometric pixel-art illustration rendered like a physical miniature diorama with photographic tilt-shift depth of field. A small new walled city offers a warm, welcoming refuge while growing from layered, weathered ruins of earlier tiny civilizations. Lovingly overdramatic and inviting, with a wink, like a miniature civilization-building game: grand emotional drama applied to an absurdly tiny society.
Scene and subject: Mossy stone city walls, little warm amber windows, an open welcoming arched gate, narrow paths, and tiny geometric machine-like inhabitants with two pinprick eyes. Beneath and around the sanctuary lie layers of broken columns and extinguished foundations. Small hopeful greenery grows among the ruins. This is an imaginative fictional allegory, not a depiction of real agents or historical events.
Composition: Beautiful three-quarter elevated camera with coherent architectural depth. Center of visual interest in the RIGHT HALF and lower middle. Keep the LEFT THIRD darker, quiet, and spacious for a live HTML headline; no lettering within the image. Full scene edge-to-edge, not an isolated white-background object. Crisp central city, softly defocused near and far terrain.
Style and materials: Intentional square pixel clusters and subtle dithering, exquisitely crafted pixel textures combined with convincing physical miniature lighting. Avoid generic 3D voxel or Minecraft appearance.
Lighting and palette: Warm sanctuary light against smoky blue and charcoal twilight surroundings; moss green accents, amber windows, desaturated blue stone.
Avoid: Readable text, letters, logos, UI, numerals, borders, badges, humans, violence, watermarks. Generate exactly one image.
